title: refactor(triage): key re-triage off the deployed workflow version
body:
Reopens #131, which GitHub closed when its base branch merged. Replaces the hand-bumped workflow version integer with the deployed package version, so there is one version.

- The hub reads each live deployment's workflow version from its frozen closure and stamps it on every run it observes from that deployment. The reconciler resets a pull request once when its recorded version differs from the live deployment's; rows that still hold the old integer count as different and re-triage once. A pull request still on an older version lets its in-flight run finish first, and an old deployment still listed during cancellation can no longer settle a pull request under the new version. Unpinned deployments reset nothing. The integer constant is deleted and verdicts no longer carry a version.
- Cost: every workflow or tool code change re-triages all open pull requests once, including the judge; the concurrency cap is unchanged.

Verified: `bun run check`; hub, web and contracts tests, including reset exactly once per version change with an old verdict still visible, a run in flight on the old version settling before the reset, an unpinned old deployment unable to settle under the new version, and integer and string versions saving and loading in Postgres.

Refs CL-XXXX
